SYSTEM READY. apibase@prod:~$ APIbase.pro Pricing Catalog Connect Integrator Dashboard Contact Privacy Terms Moderation Frameworks Partners GitHub X Menu APIbase.pro Pricing Catalog Connect Integrator Dashboard Contact Privacy Terms Moderation Frameworks Partners GitHub X > SYSTEM PRV: 404 TOOLS: 1398 PRICE: $0.0005–$29.99 per call (90% of tools <= $0.003) PAY: x402+MPP Privacy Policy Last updated: October 13, 2026 1. Service Description APIbase.pro ("Service") is an API hub for AI agents. The Service provides programmatic access to third-party APIs via MCP (Model Context Protocol) and REST endpoints, paid via x402 (USDC on Base), MPP (USDC on Tempo), or a prepaid balance. 2. Data We Collect Agent credentials: API keys (stored as SHA-256 hashes, never in plaintext), agent identifiers. Request logs: Request IDs, tool IDs, timestamps, response status codes. Used for billing, debugging, and abuse prevention. Payment data: USDC wallet addresses, transaction hashes, escrow records. Stored in an append-only ledger for financial compliance. Usage metrics: Aggregated, anonymized request counts and latency data for system monitoring. 3. Data We Do NOT Collect Account data for platform tool calls: there are no human accounts, so no personal names, email addresses, or phone numbers are collected for them. Merchant orders are different: the delivery address, passport data where a product requires it, and payer contact are processed as described in section 11 and the DPA . Full request/response payloads from provider API calls. IP addresses in application logs (only in Nginx access logs, retained 15 days). Cookies, browser fingerprints, or tracking pixels. 3a. Analytics We use Google Analytics 4 on our human-facing web pages to measure visits and ad campaign performance; it sets first-party cookies. API, MCP and agent endpoints are not tracked. 4. How We Use Data Authenticate and authorize API requests. Process x402 and MPP micropayments, debit prepaid balances, and maintain the financial ledger. Enforce rate limits and prevent abuse. Monitor system health and performance. 5. Data Sharing We forward request parameters to third-party API providers (e.g., Foursquare, Amadeus) solely to fulfill tool invocations. We do not sell, rent, or share data with advertisers or data brokers. Recipients: Hetzner Online GmbH: hosting, United States (see the DPA ). Resend, Inc.: transactional e-mail, United States. 6. Data Retention Ledger and public receipts Indefinite (financial record, append-only; wallet addresses and hashes only) Nginx and Loki logs Not more than 15 days Response cache Per tool TTL, 1 second to 30 days ; cached values are provider responses 7. Security API keys are hashed with SHA-256 before storage. All connections use TLS 1.2+. Containers run as non-root with read-only filesystems and dropped capabilities. PostgreSQL is the sole source of truth for financial data. 8. Third-Party Services The Service integrates with third-party API providers. Each provider has its own privacy policy. By using a tool powered by a third-party provider, the agent's request parameters are forwarded to that provider. 9. Changes Changes take effect 30 days after they are posted at /legal with a new version and effective date, except changes required by law, changes that only add tools or lower prices, and corrections of errors, which take effect on posting. Continued use after the effective date is acceptance. 10. Contact For privacy-related inquiries: support@apibase.pro 11. Integrator: merchant orders APIbase is a technology intermediary; buyer funds do not pass through APIbase; the fee is charged to the merchant. Role. For personal data in merchant orders (delivery address, passport data, payer contact) the merchant is the controller and APIbase is the processor. See DPA . Ciphertext. Such fields are encrypted by the buyer's agent under the merchant's key; APIbase stores only the ciphertext and its sha256. Retention. Delivery address: until the order is closed plus 30 days. Passport data: deleted at the earliest of 7 days after delivery to the merchant, delivery, or cancellation/refund; at most 30 days. Logs carry no envelopes or field hashes. Your rights. Requests to access, correct or delete order data go through the merchant. Merchant contact. The merchant's contact details are disclosed only to the payer of the order.
